items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Jack Johnson ran it for awhile. The prizefighter.

ctx.x: Dr. Summerville, and I think they ran...ran the, uh...they mixed in there somewhere, but I know the brothers. I can't think of their name but I don't think..I..I don't remember now who they were mixed in there with. Mosby ran the Dunb...the Alabam, and Dr. Summerville built the Dunbar, but he didn't run the cabaret or nothing in there. Jack Johnson ran it for awhile. The prizefighter.
